property_summary: For every admissible feeRate input (uint16), calling initialize(...) on a fresh C either sets feeRate to the provided value but only if it's <= 5000 (reference always enforces the 5000 cap), whereas the mutant allows larger feeRate values so there exist inputs (feeRate > 5000) where C.feeRate() in the mutant differs from the reference; the reference never accepts feeRate > 5000, but the mutant does.
change_summary: Remove the feeRate upper-bound check (delete the require that _feeRate <= 5000), allowing initialize to set feeRate to higher values.
